title: Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards Tool Rental Spend and the Engine Overtime Charge
content:
Tool rental spend credited to a renter's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership lowers the engine overtime charge on metered Ridgeline Tool Rental equipment.

**Rule.** ProBuild tool rental spend lowers the charge: when the ProBuild spend credited to the renter's membership from tool rentals and posted in the last 12 months totals at least 6000.00 dollars, the charge is multiplied by 0.90; when it totals at least 2500.00 but less than 6000.00 dollars, by 0.95; when it totals less than 2500.00 dollars, the charge is unchanged.

**Window.** A spend posting falls in the last 12 months when it is dated fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the day the engine overtime charge is billed. Only spend postings whose purchase channel is tool rental count.

The multiplier acts on the overtime hours multiplied by the overtime hourly price, and the rounding to the cent is made only on the final figure.

## Spend table

| Tool rental spend on the ProBuild membership in the last 12 months | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 6000.00 or more | 0.90 |
| 2500.00 to 5999.99 | 0.95 |
| below 2500.00 | 1 (unchanged) |

## Hypothetical figures (225.00 before the multiplier)

| Tool rental spend in the window | Multiplier | Figure |
|---|---|---|
| 7200.00 | 0.90 | 202.50 |
| 2500.00 | 0.95 | 213.75 |
| 1900.00 | 1 | 225.00 |
